WITH invoice_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    i.InvoiceId,
    c.Country,
    AVG(il.UnitPrice) as invoice_avg_price
  FROM Invoice i
  JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
  JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
  GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(invoice_avg_price) as overall_avg
  FROM invoice_averages
),
invoice_deviations AS (
  SELECT 
    ia.InvoiceId,
    ia.Country,
    ia.invoice_avg_price,
    (ia.invoice_avg_price - oa.overall_avg) as deviation
  FROM invoice_averages ia
  CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
),
country_avg_deviations AS (
  SELECT 
    Country,
    AVG(deviation) as country_avg_deviation
  FROM invoice_deviations
  GROUP BY Country
),
final_results AS (
  SELECT 
    id.InvoiceId,
    id.Country,
    id.invoice_avg_price,
    id.deviation,
    (id.deviation - cad.country_avg_deviation) as final_deviation
  FROM invoice_deviations id
  LEFT JOIN country_avg_deviations cad ON id.Country = cad.Country
),
with_rank AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY final_deviation DESC NULLS LAST) as rn
  FROM final_results
)
SELECT 
  InvoiceId,
  Country,
  invoice_avg_price,
  deviation,
  final_deviation
FROM with_rank
WHERE rn <= 10 OR final_deviation = (
  SELECT final_deviation 
  FROM with_rank 
  WHERE rn = 10
)
ORDER BY final_deviation DESC NULLS LAST
